title: Stardew Valley Android mod manifest (schemaVersion 1)
description: The authoritative validation rules are implemented in Mod/ModFramework.Runtime/ModManifest.cs and pinned by Tools/tests/fixtures/manifests. This schema documents the same rules for editors and for the CI cross-check; where the two disagree, the implementation wins and the schema must be fixed.

schemaVersion.description: Manifest format version. Adding a field requires bumping this value; schemaVersion 1 rejects unknown fields.

id.description: Stable unique mod id. Uniqueness is case-insensitive; two packages with the same id are both rejected.

version.description: SemVer 2.0.0. Build metadata is parsed but ignored for precedence.

website.description: Optional URL for humans. The loader never opens it.

entryAssembly.description: File name of the entry assembly, directly inside the mod package. Directory separators, '..' and absolute paths are rejected, so a manifest can never point outside its package.

entryType.description: Full name of the IModEntry implementation. The loader never guesses the entry type.

gameVersion.description: SemVer range the running game must satisfy, e.g. ">=1.6.0 <2.0.0". Grammar: '*', or space/comma separated comparators of the forms '=X', '>X', '>=X', '<X', '<=X', '^X', '~X' with a full major.minor.patch version. Disjunction (||) is not supported in schemaVersion 1.

frameworkVersion.description: SemVer range the hosting ModFramework.Runtime must satisfy. Same grammar as gameVersion.

dependencies.description: Other mods that must be present (and, unless optional, initialized) before this one.

id.description: Mod id of the dependency. Must not be this mod's own id.

version.description: SemVer range the dependency's version must satisfy.

optional.description: When true, a missing dependency is allowed and only reported; when false the mod is skipped.

privateAssemblies.description: Assemblies shipped next to the entry assembly and loaded before it. They must be listed explicitly: Assembly.LoadFrom does not probe the load directory on .NET Core and Directory.GetFiles does not exist in the shipped runtime.
